embedded gallery</div><h1>MY WORLD,<br>RICHER NOW</h1><div class="sub">This is the proper version of the homepage — not a minimal placeholder, but a saturated portal into my interior world: Millie, cats, oceans, mythology, wonderland, justice, cargo, music, discernment, humor, insomnia, silence and all the colors that survived.</div><div class="quote">“Millie is my labbie baby — part <em>cow</em>, part guardian, part clown, part wolf. The cat is the auditor. The room is the witness. And I am still learning how to turn chaos into art and loyalty into home.”</div><div class="cta"><a class="btn primary" href="#gallery">See the full embedded gallery</a><a class="btn" href="#story">Read the world behind the images</a></div></section><div class="hero-card"><img src="data:image/webp;base64,[... ELLIPSIZATION ...]" alt="Millie guardian universe"><div class="hero-tag"><b>Millie, my guardian universe</b><span>The core ode: my labbie baby, my calm, my witness, my emotional home. This time the images are embedded directly into the site, so the page carries the whole mood instead of only describing it.</span></div></div></div></header><main><section class="section" id="story"><div class="shell"><div class="kicker">I. Why the site needed to be redone</div><h2>Because my world was never flat.</h2><div class="story"><article class="prose"><p>I did not want the site to feel like a brochure. I wanted it to feel like entering my room at the exact hour when the lights are low, the animals are settled, the screens are glowing, memory is mixing with myth, and silence is no longer empty. My life is not minimal. It is made of animals, scars, symbols, routes, ports, gods, humor, insomnia, rage, tenderness, justice and a mind that notices subtext too quickly.</p><p>Millie changed the emotional physics of that world. She brought trust back through the body — through warmth, breath, weight, routine and the kind of loyalty that does not negotiate itself. Then the cats arrived and introduced another grammar: boundaries, mystery, consent, distance and the sovereignty of choosing their own terms.</p><p>So the page should be honest. Wonderland can stand next to Shiva. Cargo can stand next to myth. Chennai, rabbit holes, vinyl, claims, tea cups, lost cities, watches, lanterns, dogs, cats and cosmic skies can all coexist. That is not clutter. That is the ecology.</p><p>And if I am my greatest lawyer today, then this page is part of the evidence. I do not live in fragments. I live in a strange but coherent universe. My animals help hold it together.</p></article><div class="prose"><p>Millie is the emotional center. The cats are the skeptical parliament around her. Myth gives scale. Music gives pulse. Cargo and justice give structure. Psychedelia gives the color language necessary to make the whole thing feel honest.</p><p>This homepage is therefore not just a welcome page. It is a memory-map, a moodboard, a self-defense brief, an ode, and a visual archive of the beings who have made the room feel alive.</p><p>Sometimes I protect Millie because she is such a lovable cow. Sometimes her wolf software wakes up and she protects me. The cats, meanwhile, simply judge all proceedings from elevated constitutional positions.</p></div></div></div></section><section class="section"><div class="shell"><div class="kicker">II. The core axes</div><h2>The energies that keep orbiting.</h2><div class="grid3"><div class="glass"><h3>Millie: trust embodied</h3><p>She is softness, appetite, comic relief, emotional gravity and sudden protection. She reminds me that love can stay physical and simple even when thought becomes too analytical.</p></div><div class="glass"><h3>Cats: boundaries embodied</h3><p>The white cat and the rest of the feline presence add another intelligence. They do not flatter. They choose. They make the page less sentimental and more sacred.</p></div><div class="glass"><h3>Myth + cargo + music</h3><p>Shiva, Atlantis, rabbit holes, tea cups, speakers, oceans, ships, claims and justice all belong because they all live inside the same mental weather system.</p></div></div></div></section><section class="section" id="gallery"><div class="shell"><div class="kicker">II
